text:
mira: Noticing a weird dip in playbook delivery success rate this morning for the EU cohort. Delivery rate fell from 98% -> 87% around 05:10 UTC. AMs flagged bounced nudges.

ash: I saw that too. Graph shows spike coincident with the mail relay switch to `smtp-eu-2`. Logs: `notify.error=temporary_failure reason=421 4.7.0 try_later`. Seems transient but playbook runner treats these as permanent failures and marks accounts as "no_contact" which is triggering churn score drift.

cs-ops-bot: alert: playbook.delivery_drop 05:18 UTC cohort=eu flagged_increase=132 (:rotating_light:)

jon (eng): We added exponential retry but runner also flips `contact_status=no` on first permanent-looking error. I'll patch runner to only mark `no_contact` after N=3 consecutive permanent errors or 72h window. Quick PR: https://git.redwood/s/cs/playbook/+/309 (small guard).

paul: Also, can we backfill contact attempts for impacted accounts so healthscore recalculation doesn't penalize them? If we can inject a synthetic `notify_suppressed=true` event that indicates retry_in_progress, scorer can ignore the no_contact.

vivian: Good idea. I can add `notify_suppressed` in the event stream for runs between 05:00-05:30 where relay errors match `smtp-eu-2`. Script I'll run: `python tools/ingest_suppression.py --run 3098765432 --reason relay-temporary --out s3://redwood-cs/ingest/3098765432.json`

mira: Please mute churn alerts while we fix and backfill, otherwise AMs will receive a flood. @ash can you pause `healthscore.delta` alerts for tag=playbook-relay until 3098766100?

ash: Pausing alerts now. Done.

jon (eng): I've opened the runner guard PR and will roll to staging canary immediately. If staging passes I'll roll prod patch within 1h.

cs-ops-bot: runner-deploy canary started by jon at 05:36 UTC

paul: I'll prepare the backfill payload. Need the affected account list. Query I ran: `SELECT acct_id FROM playbook_runs WHERE run_ts BETWEEN '2026-10-12 05:00' AND '2026-10-12 05:30' AND notify_error LIKE '%smtp-eu-2%'` -> s3://redwood-cs/incidents/3098765432/affected_accounts.csv

vivian: Running suppression ingest dry-run now. Command: `python tools/ingest_suppression.py --dry-run --in s3://redwood-cs/incidents/3098765432/affected_accounts.csv --out /tmp/supp.csv`

cs-ops-bot: suppression-dryrun completed: candidates=132 would_write=132 s3://redwood-cs/ingest/3098765432/dry.csv

mira: Good. After we backfill, let's run a quick healthscore recalculation for that cohort and compare flags before/after to confirm FP reduction. Who can run the dry-recalc?

jon (eng): I can trigger `./bin/healthscore --cohort eu-onboard --dry-run --patch=ignore-transient-relay --out s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/3098765432/health_recalc.json`. ETA ~20m.

ash: Also let's add a monitoring rule: if external relay returns 4xx/5xx for >1% of messages in 5m window, open a pager but keep it informational for 30m before flipping playbook contact statuses. We need to avoid immediate scoring impacts.

mira: Agree. Add as action item for next sprint. For now, plan: 1) apply runner guard in staging -> canary 2) run suppression backfill 3) dry-run healthscore recalc 4) if FP drop confirmed, merge and release 5) AM note with impacted accounts + apology.

vivian: Backfill write started to SQS queue (not yet committed). I'll wait for staging guard to land so scorer rule aligns.

cs-ops-bot: healthscore dry-run queued by jon (ETA 20m) (:hourglass_flowing_sand:)

mira: Thanks team. Once we converge on patch+backfill I'll prepare the AM communication and coordinate with support to field replies. Appreciate the quick triage :pray:
